title: Stats
summary: Every stat in SkyRPG, what it does, where it comes from and the formulas for damage, crits, defence and mana.

s.x: Stats are the numbers that make your character stronger. Gear, skill levels, pets, talents and slayer levels all add to them, and the game adds them up twice a second. This page lists every stat, what it does in the game, and the maths behind combat. Open the
page in the K menu to see your own totals; hover a stat to see how much each source adds.
Every player starts with a base value for each stat (the table below). Sources add to it.
Stats come from your armour, weapon, accessories and set bonuses, from your skill levels, from pets, from talents, and from slayer levels. See
Health and damage use SkyRPG's own scale:
5 SkyRPG health is 1 vanilla health point
. 100 Health is 20 vanilla points, which is 10 hearts. Damage numbers, mob nameplates and boss bars all use the same scale.

Other multipliers apply on top, multiplied together: damage bonuses against certain mobs (slayer weapons and the Cryptbreaker), and the damage reductions bosses have (wards, tougher-than-vanilla health). See
Worked example: a 120 Damage weapon, 100 Strength, 30% Crit Chance and 50% Crit Damage.
Crit Chance above 100% is wasted: you already crit every time. Crit Damage is then worth more than more Crit Chance.

Crit Chance and Crit Damage multiply each other, so the lower one is worth more per point. A point of Crit Chance adds 1% of your Crit Damage to your average hit, and a point of Crit Damage adds 1% of your Crit Chance. With the starting 30% and 50%, a point of Crit Chance is the better buy.

s.x: When you break a block that counts (ores, grown crops, logs), it drops its normal drops again once for every full 100 Fortune, plus a chance for one more from the remainder. With 250 Fortune you get 2 extra copies and a 50% chance of a third. Crops only count when fully grown, and ores do not give extra drops if you mine them with Silk Touch. See

Skills give a fixed amount per level (50 levels each). Delving has talents too.
Slayer levels add a small stat per level too: Grave Tyrant +3 Health, Broodmother +0.5% Crit Chance, Bone Marshal +1 Strength, Void Stalker +2 Intelligence. See
Weapon Damage is not a player stat. Only the weapon you hold carries it, and nothing can add to it.
